Every revival-authored skill or advanced movement shows a regression for use when clean form is unavailable. For a base movement with no lower rung or an authentic legacy exercise, reduce range, support, assistance, repetitions, or sets conservatively. Stop for sharp joint pain.

This prescription is preserved from the legacy APK and may be excessive. “Max” means stop when technique starts to break, not absolute failure. Keep 2–3 reps in reserve and cap effort around RPE 8. Reduce range, add assistance, or scale sets and reps; skip behind-the-neck, head-banger, or any painful movement.

Warm up before loading skills. Perform the prescribed variation only with clean control; otherwise use its displayed regression. If no lower rung is listed, reduce range, support, assistance, repetitions, or sets. Leave repetitions in reserve and do not force German-hang or shoulder range. Stop for sharp pain, numbness, dizziness, or loss of control. Persistent symptoms need qualified medical advice.

“APK authentic” means exercise details came from the Base APK. “Revival reconstruction,” “Revival extension,” and “New level” are original additions, not recovered Pro data. Historic videos open only as public Vimeo links.
